verdict.rationale: A probe got HTTP 200 at https://motherduck.com/openapi.json, and the response contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. However, no first-party documentation describes the spec, which API surface it covers, or how complete and current it is. Missing for 10: first-party docs referencing the OpenAPI spec, evidence of its scope and completeness, independent or hands-on corroboration of its use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://motherduck.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
